LanguageData.PhobosDmsLegionPatches_SettingRadiationB: Legion's nuclear strike: dose by distance and shelter

On (the default): after The Dead Man's Switch - Legion's nuclear strike, each person takes a radiation dose by how far they were from it and what covered them: roofs, stone walls, rock and vehicle hulls cut it, and people deep in a mountain can live. A letter names your people who took one. Its blast, heat and toxic fallout stay Legion's own. Off: Legion's own radiation, which kills everyone on the map within seconds, bunkers included.
LanguageData.PhobosDmsLegionPatches_NeedsModel: This needs D'thorga Medical's radiation model, which is not on: until it is, Legion's own radiation runs.
